models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B

engines.hardware: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo) single system with 128GB unified LPDDR5X, GPU able to address ~96-110GB of the pool; Vulkan generally edges out ROCm for generation here
engines.quant: aggressive ~Q3 quantization bringing the weights to ~100GB; real-world generation lands at 14-17 tok/s

models.why: Lisa Su's lunchbox demo made concrete: Qwen3-235B-A22B at ~Q3 (~100GB) on one 128GB Strix Halo mini PC really generates ~14-17 tok/s (Vulkan over ROCm) — conversationally usable, not fast; the "3x faster than an RTX 5080" claim only holds for models that do not fit 16GB.
